stories.title: Brazil's election heads to a runoff as Flavio Bolsonaro edges Lula in the first round
stories.reason: With 99.96% of polling stations counted, Bolsonaro took 47.04% to Lula's 45.15%, a gap of about 2.25 million votes, setting up an October 25 runoff that will test whether the president can win a fourth term against the resurgent Bolsonaro movement.

stories.title: Congo's Ebola death toll passes 4,000 in what officials call the fastest-growing outbreak in history
stories.reason: Among roughly 8,300 cases since May, an Ebola treatment center was burned down and at least 50 health workers have died, with North Kivu now accounting for nearly 40% of new cases as the outbreak threatens to surpass West Africa's 2014-16 epidemic.

stories.title: The US withdraws all its B-1 bombers from a UK air base after a suspected Iran-linked terror plot
stories.reason: All 12 bombers left RAF Fairford a week after several men, including a UK-Iranian dual national, were arrested over a suspected plot targeting the base, which UK officials say shows 'strong indications' of Iranian involvement that Tehran denies.

stories.title: Trump names four officials to lead a new 'Super Intelligence Force' on AI policy
stories.reason: DNI Jay Clayton will chair the group alongside FTC Chair Andrew Ferguson, Pentagon tech official Emil Michael and OPM Director Scott Kupor, tasked with coordinating the government's engagement with AI companies and the public as safety concerns mount.

stories.title: Ethiopian federal forces retake Mekelle airport from Tigrayan fighters, residents say
stories.reason: TPLF fighters had seized the airport on September 23, halting commercial flights, and the reported recapture comes as renewed fighting undermines the 2022 Pretoria peace deal and coincides with Ethiopia's diplomatic rupture with Eritrea.

stories.title: Bosnian Serb leader Dodik's party holds its grip on Republika Srpska in a vote with EU stakes
stories.reason: Preliminary results show Dodik's SNSD ally Zeljka Cvijanovic leading the Serb seat on Bosnia's tripartite presidency, a result that could further complicate the country's stalled EU membership bid amid competing Russian and Western influence.

stories.title: Micron extends its AI memory demand forecast to 2031 as customers lock in longer supply deals
stories.reason: The chipmaker has now signed 26 multiyear strategic customer agreements, up from 16 in June, covering more than 35% of its revenue through 2030, as it warns supply will stay tighter than demand through 2027 and 2028.

stories.title: A highway crash in Kenya kills at least 17 people, most of them Catholic pilgrims
stories.reason: A truck's failed overtaking maneuver caused a multi-vehicle collision near Salama, about 90km southeast of Nairobi, striking a minibus of pilgrims headed to a prayer site in Nakuru County, prompting President Ruto to offer condolences.
